title: Administration
subtitle: Workforce, finance, pharmacy oversight and system control in one console

overview.lead: The Admin console is where the clinic is run, not just used. One operations dashboard surfaces revenue, patients, staffing, stock risk and patient growth; from there the administrator manages the workforce, runs payroll, records procurement, and reviews a real-time audit of every sensitive action. It is the management layer over the pharmacy, cashier, lab and clinical modules.
highlights: Operations dashboard — revenue, patients, staff, low-stock, patient growth
Inventory oversight with a New Stock Order procurement flow
Staff directory with profile drill-in, role-create and archive
Payroll runs with line adjustments and a finalized-run lock
Real-time, filterable security & system audit ledger
Cash-collected and revenue trend on the live dashboard

dashboard.title: Operations dashboard
dashboard.description: The administrator opens to a live operations dashboard: 30-day revenue with trend, today's patients, active staff, critical low-stock, and a computed patient-growth metric (new registrations vs the prior period). It is the one-screen pulse of the clinic.
bullets: Live activity feed of clinic actions
dashboard.impact: The owner sees the health of the business at a glance, every morning.

inventory.title: Inventory & procurement
inventory.description: Admin oversees pharmacy stock health — total value, low-stock alerts and an expiry watchlist — and records a new supplier purchase directly through a New Stock Order flow that writes through the same trigger chain the pharmacy uses, so stock stays consistent.
bullets: Stock value, low-stock and expiry watchlist
New Stock Order — supplier purchase from the admin console
Writes via the pharmacy trigger chain (consistent stock)
inventory.impact: Management can act on stock risk and reorder without leaving the console.

staff.title: Staff directory
staff.description: A full workforce directory covers staff and doctors, with a profile drill-in, role-based onboarding (including creating real doctor accounts), and one-click archive/reactivate. Status and role are clear at a glance.
bullets: Staff and doctors in one searchable directory
Create staff or real doctor accounts by role
Employment status and role at a glance
staff.impact: The whole workforce is managed from one place, cleanly and auditably.

payroll.title: Payroll runs
payroll.description: Payroll is generated month-wise, reviewed line by line with manual adjustments where needed, and then finalized — after which the run is locked and immutable. The finalized-run lock protects paid payroll from silent edits.
bullets: Per-line manual adjustments on draft runs
payroll.impact: Payroll is flexible while drafting and tamper-proof once finalized.

audit.title: Security & system audit
audit.description: Every sensitive administrative action is written to a real-time audit ledger, filterable by date range and by severity (critical actions like reversals, deletions and reopens), and exportable to CSV for compliance.
bullets: Actor, action, entity and timestamp on every row
audit.impact: Accountability for every sensitive action, ready for an auditor.

closing.lead: The console that runs the clinic
points: One management layer over pharmacy, cashier, lab and clinical modules.
Sensitive actions are audited; finalized payroll and stock are protected.
Procurement writes through the same trigger chain as the pharmacy.
Every figure here is live from the running system on realistic demo data.
